description: The CodeBoarding-action system operates as a linear pipeline within a GitHub Action environment, transforming raw source code changes into visual architectural insights through orchestration, structural diffing, visualization, and integration layers.

components.name: Analysis Orchestrator
components.description: Acts as the central controller for the action. It validates the environment, manages the transition between full codebase scans and incremental PR analysis, and ensures metadata consistency across runs.

components.name: Workflow Lifecycle Controller
components.description: Acts as the primary entry point and high-level coordinator. It manages the sequential execution of the action, handles quota enforcement to prevent runaway CI costs, and dispatches tasks to the strategy and validation layers.

components.name: Strategy & State Manager
components.description: The decision-making engine that determines the analysis mode (Full vs. Incremental). It tracks commit hashes and metadata to ensure that PR analysis only processes changed files, maintaining consistency with the established baseline.

components.name: Integrity & Health Guard
components.description: Performs pre-flight validation of the environment and post-analysis quality checks. It specifically looks for "baseline drift"—where documentation becomes desynchronized from the code—and reports on the structural integrity of the generated Mermaid diagrams.

components_relations.relation: provides metadata for depth and drift checks

components.name: Structural Diffing Engine
components.description: Analyzes the codebase to identify structural modifications. It maps file-level changes to architectural components and extracts method-level differences to determine the scope of the impact.

components.name: Change Discovery & Scope Extractor
components.description: Acts as the entry point for the engine by interfacing with the Git environment to identify modified files and drilling down into the specific code symbols affected within those files.

components.name: Architectural Mapper & Identity Manager
components.description: Translates physical file paths into logical architectural components, handling normalization, unique ID generation, and metadata management for component-level updates.

components.name: Impact Analyzer & Visualizer
components.description: Compares component states before and after changes to determine modification types and aggregates findings into visual Mermaid.js flow and status reports.

components_relations.relation: Passes identified file paths and method-level scopes to be resolved into logical component identities.
Provides the mapped component metadata and sanitized names required to build the structural comparison.
Supplies the raw change data used to evaluate _has_changes logic during the final visualization phase.

components.name: Mermaid Visualization Engine
components.description: Translates the structural diff data into Mermaid.js syntax. It handles the recursive rendering of nested components, applies status indicators (added/modified/deleted), and filters noise to ensure diagram readability.

components.name: Diagram Orchestration & Change Detection
components.description: Acts as the entry point for the visualization process, identifying components requiring re-rendering by analyzing Git diffs and managing the lifecycle of generated diagram files.

components.name: Recursive Syntax Generator
components.description: The core logic engine that translates internal component models into Mermaid syntax through recursive traversal of nested structures.

components_relations.relation: Passes filtered component subtrees and change-sets to initiate the string-building process
Uses internal recursion to handle nested architectural layers

components.name: UX & Integration Layer
components.description: Manages the final presentation of data to the user, including GitHub comments, feedback loops, and external integrations. It handles telemetry and user feedback via PostHog, closing the feedback loop between the user and the tool. Key class/method: scripts.submit_feedback.py.

components.name: Visual Report Engine
components.description: Translates structural analysis and diff data into human-readable formats, primarily Mermaid.js diagrams and component-level documentation.

components.name: IDE & Environment Bridge
components.description: Enhances generated reports with interactive Call-to-Action elements and generates deep links for local editor navigation.

components.name: Engagement & Telemetry Handler
components.description: Manages the outbound feedback loop by collecting user interactions and submitting telemetry data to PostHog.

components_relations.relation: configures telemetry settings and host routing
provides structural diff data for rendering
queries file-level changes for component mapping
provides rendered diagrams for GitHub comments
reports telemetry and user feedback status
